WE’RE PROTEUS SPORTS GROUP

SPORT BRINGS
US TOGETHER.

Established in 2018 to provide accessible coaching to any player, organisation or sporting environment, regardless of level or ability. Today nearly 60 coaches deliver across Canterbury, and people are at the heart of everything we do.

QUALITY COACHING. STRONGER COMMUNITIES.

OUR STORY

BUILT FOR
TRANSFORMATION.

Proteus Sports Group was founded in 2018 by Oliver Hawkins and Myles Gardner. Proteus was the Greek god who could change his form, and transformation is what we’re about: shaping players, building skills and helping people become better team-mates. We take pride in creating employment and coaching opportunities in the local sports industry, strengthening the wider sporting ecosystem.

Since 2019 we’ve built long-term partnerships with colleges, clubs and organisations throughout Canterbury. Through them we recruit, support and manage coaching programmes, establish new initiatives and help sporting structures grow. Our network means we deliver more than coaching, with the operational support and sports business capability to create impact well beyond the session.

OUR SPECIALITY

FOOTBALL
AT OUR CORE.

We work across many sports and communities, but our coaching foundations are rooted in football. With more than 10 years in the industry, our expertise spans grassroots and amateur football through to semi-professional and high-performance settings.

Our football operations are led by our Director, an OFC A Licence coach who also oversees the academy and first-team environments at a large membership-based club. We have a track record of helping players progress well beyond the environments where they started.

10+Years in footballOFC ALicence-qualified Director

OUR COACHING PHILOSOPHY

Football is the foundation of our methodology. Its principles shape how we coach every sport, with emphasis on:

  • Technical and fundamental skill development
  • Individual player development and progression
  • Decision-making, game understanding and tactical awareness
  • Confidence, resilience and accountability
  • Positive, challenging and engaging learning environments
  • Coaches who understand the technical and human sides of sport
  • Clear development pathways and progression opportunities
